description: 10 conversation threads between an AI agent and a simulated caller, produced by an automated evaluation run in the dev environment. The agent is a triage screener for Medi-Cal renewal outreach: it must find out whether the caller wants phone help renewing, whether their coverage is active, whether they have other insurance, whether they live in San Diego County, and whether they received the county's yellow renewal packet — then route them correctly (complete the renewal, schedule a callback, refer them, or close out). Each thread is an independent episode: same agent, different simulated caller situations covering different paths through the screening.
notes: The caller is an LLM simulation, not a real person; all personal details are synthetic.
The first agent message is the agent's opener; after that, each turn is a caller message followed by the agent's reply.
Threads vary in how well the agent handled the call; that variance is the point of the dataset.

agent_config is the configuration of the agent that produced these threads (its screening items and outcomes are the intended behavior to evaluate against). team_config is the team it belongs to; the evaluation run exercised this one agent standalone, not the full team sequence. Configs were last updated 2026-07-02; the episodes ran 2026-07-01.
